To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
youth speakers of the igbo language are using social media to communicate with each other in a language that is different from that of their parents and grandparents.

the use of social media platforms by the youth speakers of the igbo language is not only an avenue to communicate, but a way to create individual, social, and perhaps in-group identities, thereby forming binding and alienating mechanism through norm deviation.
social media platforms have had an impact on the cultural norms and language of the youths.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of social media on the Igbo language, the youth language and the implications on the cultural norms.
the implication of youth language on cultural norms of Igbo speakers.
how social media identity and language have affected the cultural norms of Igbo youth speakers, and what implications this has on the language and its speakers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the youth language is a reflection of their identity.

, the youth language of the Igbo speaking youths has been greatly influenced by the social media and this has led to a lot of norm deviation and a lot of social media related issues like cyberbullying, social isolation etc.
social media is a powerful tool of communication, but it is also a powerful tool of destruction of cultural norms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
social media platforms are not only a means of communication, but also a means of creating and sustaining a social identity.
, the youths are gradually losing their cultural norms through the adoption of the western culture and its language.
the youths are using the social media as a platform for their language and cultural identity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social media has become an integral part of the youths’ daily lives and the way they communicate.
social media has become a major factor in the development and use of language.
the youths have created their own language, which is a mixture of the local language and English.
